entries.detail: Reference design 2026-06-30-rates-aws2x-DESIGN-claude.md summary: ONLY DynamoDB in scope (no S3/SQS/SNS/SES/Kinesis). Booking already migrated a byte-for-byte twin at com.inttra.mercury.booking.carrierspotrates.model.canonical.SpotRatesDetail (same table SpotRatesDetail, hash key spotRateKey, GSI SPOT_RATE_ID_INDEX on spotRateId, @TTL expiresOn epoch-seconds, SpotRates/Audit). Plan: pom (remove dynamo-client + prod aws-java-sdk-dynamodb; add cloud-sdk-api/cloud-sdk-aws + dynamo-integration-test + test-scoped aws-java-sdk-dynamodb; pin Jackson); SpotRateConfig.dynamoDbConfig DynamoDbConfig->BaseDynamoDbConfig; SpotRatesModule drop AmazonDynamoDB/DynamoDBMapper bindings -> DynamoDbClientConfig + SpotRatesDao providers via DynamoRepositoryFactory.createEnhancedRepository; delete DynamoSupport; SpotRatesDetail v1 ORM -> @DynamoDbBean/@Table + enhanced annotations + converters (SpotRatesAttributeConverter, DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter, AuditAttributeConverter - verify byte-identity to booking); SpotRatesDao extends DynamoDBCrudRepository -> injected DatabaseRepository<...,DefaultPartitionKey<String>> with DefaultQuerySpec, preserve GSI->hash-key two-step; drop stray v1 @DynamoDBDocument/@DynamoDBTypeConvertedEnum on networkservices ContainerType. NOTE: no table-bootstrap/CreateTables command in rates (externally provisioned) => Step 3B command-name/CI $task likely NO change. Backward-compat: shared *_booking namespace, wire shape must match booking exactly. CVT prefix inttra2_test_booking; PROD sseEnabled true. Goal: commons 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT (design doc said 1.0.26, goal overrides to 1.0.28).

entries.summary: Analyzed current rates code + booking twin template. Implementation plan finalized incl API preservation and byte-compat notes.
entries.detail:
Booking twin fully migrated - use as exact template: SpotRatesDetail (@Table/@DynamoDbBean, @DynamoDbPartitionKey spotRateKey, @GsiConfig+@DynamoDbSecondaryPartitionKey SPOT_RATE_ID_INDEX KEYS_ONLY, @TTL+@DynamoDbConvertedBy(DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter) expiresOn, @DynamoDbConvertedBy(SpotRatesAttributeConverter/AuditAttributeConverter)); SpotRatesAttributeConverter (S, <fqcn>:<json> or <len>|<fqcn>:<b64gzip> >300KB, FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false + SORT_PROPERTIES_ALPHABETICALLY=true; transformTo IGNORES stored fqcn -> readValue into own SpotRates.class = robust cross-module read); AuditAttributeConverter (M map via LegacyMapConverter + DYNAMO_OBJECT_MAPPER writing ISO_DATE_TIME 'Z', tolerant OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter read incl +0000 and ISO_DATE fallback); LegacyMapConverter (empty String -> NUL, null -> NUL); DAO uses DefaultQuerySpec partitionKeyValue+consistentRead(true) for findByOfferKey (returns List), GSI query for findBySpotRateId then findByOfferKey. Guice: BookingDynamoModule provides DynamoDbClientConfig via BaseDynamoDbConfig.toClientConfigBuilder().consistentRead(false), createEnhancedRepository(clientConfig, tablePrefix+@Table.name, domain, DynamoRepositoryConfig). RATES SPECIFICS: keep rates.SpotRates FQCN; DO NOT register BookingStateConverter (rates has no BookingState - v1 had it commented out); use rates.common.GZip (byte-compatible standard GZIP); preserve rates DAO API: findBySpotRateId(String) [SpotRatesService], saveSpotRates(String,Audit,String,SpotRates) 4-arg [MaerskSpotRatesClient uses spotRates.getSpotRateId()], findByOfferKey(String). Port OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter (booking's tolerant v2 non-DynamoDBTypeConverter version). Tests to rewrite: SpotRatesDaoTest, SpotRatesConverterTest, DateToEpochSecondTest, SpotRatesModuleTest; DELETE DynamoSupportTest (class removed). Add SpotRatesDaoIT (mirror booking SpotRatesDaoIT). Drop v1 annotations on networkservices ContainerType.</detail>

entries.summary: Develop boot-check FLAGGED: app compiles + Dropwizard starts, but full boot blocked by external INT auth-gateway HTTP 502 (environmental, out of scope). Decision: proceed with clear flag; defer runtime boot to deployed INT.
entries.detail:
DEVELOP BOOT-CHECK (FLAGGED): `java -jar target/rates-1.0.jar server conf/int/config.yaml` on latest develop. Result: develop COMPILES (BUILD SUCCESS) and Dropwizard initializes (DefaultServerFactory registers jersey handler '/' and admin handler '/admin'), but full boot fails during Guice provisioning because ContainerTypeClient eagerly loads a container-type cache at construction -> NetworkClient -> AuthClient.newToken() -> external INT auth token endpoint returns HTTP 502 Bad Gateway (3 retries), throwing WebApplicationException 'Could not retrieve a new token' -> Guice ProvisionException. Reproduced twice, deterministic. Direct probe of https://api-test.inttra.com/auth/validate returns HTTP 400 (endpoint reachable), so this is an environmental limitation of the local machine reaching the INT OAuth token gateway, NOT a develop code defect and NOT related to the DynamoDB/AWS-upgrade scope (which does not touch auth/network/containertype client code). DECISION: The boot-check's purpose is to confirm develop is not broken before building on it; develop is sound (compiles + starts Dropwizard). The sole boot blocker is an external auth-gateway 502 that is identical pre/post my change and outside scope. Per autonomy guidance (user unavailable, 'make good decisions'), PROCEEDING with implementation while prominently flagging this. Full runtime boot verification deferred to the deployed INT environment (Step 3B ECS/log verification); local correctness gate = mvn clean verify incl. DynamoDB-Local integration tests.</detail>

entries.summary: INT deployed develop fails identically to local boot (auth 502 in eager ContainerTypeClient load) => INT env infra issue, not code. QA runs fine (steady state).
entries.detail:
INT ECS root-cause confirmed via CloudWatch (log group inttra-int-lg-rates, stream Rates-latest-dev-Task/Rates-dev-Container/<taskId>). The DEPLOYED DEVELOP artifact Rates-26.06.003.jar exits code 1 with the IDENTICAL failure as the local boot-check: startup registers jersey/admin handlers, 'DynamoSupport: Created mapper with environment prefix inttra_int_booking_' (old v1 DynamoDB inits fine), then AuthClient.newToken (AuthClient.java:56) -> HTTP 502 Bad Gateway, called from ContainerTypeClient$3.load (ContainerTypeClient.java:96/90) via Guava LocalCache load -> NetworkClient.get. stoppedReason 'Essential container in task exited', stopCode EssentialContainerExited, exitCode 1. So the INT boot failure is an INT-environment infrastructure issue (INT auth/OAuth gateway returning 502), reproduced by BOTH the deployed develop build and my local boot-check - NOT a code defect and orthogonal to the DynamoDB migration. QA in contrast: ECS Rates-qa desired=1 running=1 rollout COMPLETED 'reached a steady state' - the rates app IS running fine in QA (QA auth gateway healthy). Eager load mechanism: ISOContainerToTmContainer (@Singleton, contract/service) constructor calls getIsoContainerCodesFromMap -> for each ISO code in contract-rates/ISOContainerToTMContainerMap.csv calls ContainerTypeClient.getContainerGroupType -> Guava ServiceCache load -> networkClient.get(containertype service) -> AuthClient token -> external network/auth call at STARTUP (Guice/Dropwizard init), before server binds. If auth/network unreachable, startup aborts.</detail>

entries.summary: Deep dive: INT api-alpha gateway fully 502 (down). booking shares same gateway but boots (lazy auth); rates crashes because ISOContainerToTmContainer eagerly warms cache at startup. QA=same code, healthy api-beta, running.
entries.detail:
DEEP ROOT-CAUSE of INT boot failure (user asked why rates fails but booking/network don't). Verified: (1) INT gateway api-alpha.inttra.com is FULLY DOWN - HTTP 502 on /auth, /auth/validate AND /network/containertype (not auth-specific, whole gateway 502). QA api-beta returns 400/401 (up), CVT api-test 400 (up), PROD api 400 (up). (2) Per-env auth/gateway URLs differ: INT=api-alpha, QA=api-beta, CVT=api-test, PROD=api. (3) booking INT uses the SAME api-alpha gateway (securityResources.oauthTokenValidationUri + outbound auth both api-alpha) - so it is NOT a different/broken endpoint unique to rates; the gateway is shared. (4) The real difference is TIMING: rates ISOContainerToTmContainer (@Singleton, contract/service) constructor EAGERLY warms the container-type cache at startup (getIsoContainerCodesFromMap -> ContainerTypeClient.getContainerGroupType per ISO code -> NetworkClient -> AuthClient GET api-alpha) so an api-alpha 502 throws during Guice provisioning -> essential container exits(1) -> ECS task dies. booking/network authenticate LAZILY (commons securityResources inbound validation per-request; their Guava ServiceCache/CacheLoader caches load on first get, not at boot) so the same outage does NOT crash their boot - they stay ECS-running and only fail requests needing the down gateway. rates' own ServiceCache is itself a lazy Guava LoadingCache; boot-fragility is solely the eager warm-up in ISOContainerToTmContainer's constructor (eager-cache-warm anti-pattern). (5) QA calls the IDENTICAL code steps as INT (same eager path) but against healthy api-beta => QA ECS Rates-qa running=1 steady state. CONCLUSION: proceeding past the failing boot-check was correct (user endorsed); INT failure = api-alpha platform outage affecting deployed develop too, orthogonal to the DynamoDB change. Documented in rates/docs/2026-07-24-rates-owasp-aws-upgrade.md sections 6 and 9(c).</detail>

(2) SpotRatesModule.provideDynamoDbClientConfig() no longer injects RatesConfig (reviewer importance 8: module never binds RatesConfig; only worked because RatesModule binds it) - now uses the ratesConfig constructor field; SpotRatesModuleTest builds injector from SpotRatesModule alone (no external RatesConfig binding). (3) Removed the temporary <lombok.version>1.18.32</lombok.version> pin - 3x clean test-compile + 2x clean verify green without it; parent processor 1.18.30 works against commons classpath 1.18.32 (same as booking); earlier failures were stale-target flakiness. Review Q2 (Audit): IS persisted, but as a nested DynamoDB Map via @DynamoDbConvertedBy(AuditAttributeConverter.class) on SpotRatesDetail.getAudit() - the enhanced client needs no @DynamoDbBean/annotation on Audit itself (matches booking's Audit).
